breakdown.description: The stem constraints are rotated from the stated tangential condition u_y = 0 on vertical stems to a normal condition u_x = 0
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to impose a normal displacement condition (u_x = 0) on the vertical stems, contradicting the correct tangential condition (u_y = 0) mentioned earlier in the same prompt. The generated specification repeated the incorrect instruction, stating to impose 'roller (zero normal displacement) conditions... by setting uₓ = 0 on those edges.' The ground truth correctly uses the u_y = 0 constraint.
